caption: The reference monitor checks each request against the domain. The domain needs only the two highlighted rights (2 in all); the wide grant gives 24 rights, so 22 are excess.

spec.title: Exam cell: 12 files, 2 needed, 24 granted
spec.aria: A 12-file table shows the 2 rights the exam cell program needs (read on results.dat, append on audit.log) and a wide grant of read and write on all 12 files, which is 24 rights and 22 more than needed.
